current_row.title: Residual Fault Adaptation for Dexterous In-Hand Manipulation Under Runtime Joint Faults
current_row.short: Residual Fault Adaptation for Dexterous In-Hand Manipulation Under Runtime Joint Faults
current_row.one_line: Frozen healthy teacher plus recurrent residual policy, trained with fault-injection randomization and adaptive fault sampling, compensates hidden single-joint command faults without fault labels; beats the healthy policy in sim and deploys zero-shot on a real LEAP Hand with software-injected faults.

current_row.title: Intrinsic Robot Rewarding: Reusing VLA Representations for Autonomous Evaluation and Policy Improvement
current_row.one_line: Position paper: reuse the VLA's frozen visual encoder plus a reference bank of successful demonstration endpoints as a built-in reward/evaluator, avoiding a separate reward model; COMAU Racer 3 demonstrator at TRL 4, no policy-improvement results yet.

current_row.title: Learning Multimodal One-step Flow Policy via Value-weighted Optimal Transport
current_row.one_line: Offline RL: state-wise entropic optimal transport couples a value-aware reference flow policy to a one-step policy, prioritizing high-value distillation targets without direct critic maximization; best state-based OGBench average (48.3 vs 45.6 for GFP).

current_row.title: Refinement-Based Flow Policy Optimization
current_row.one_line: Online RL for flow policies: refines the policy's own samples toward a Q-induced energy-based distribution, then flow-matches to them. Matches or beats SAC on 5 of 6 MuJoCo tasks (not Hopper); fits six synthetic 2D multimodal targets without mode collapse.

current_row.title: Steering Generative Robot Policies with Lexicographic Preferences
current_row.one_line: Dynamic-barrier guidance protects higher-priority costs to first order; cascade selection chooses among frozen-policy samples. Navigation success: 44.3% base to 56.0%, versus selection-only 48.0% and weighted-sum guidance 50.7%.

current_row.title: Real-World Reinforcement Learning with MPC Scaffolding for Dexterous Manipulation
current_row.one_line: MPC data, BC/Soft-SARSA pretraining and guidance seed SAC on an Allegro hand; first 5/5 after 7.4 min, then 100% at 55 deg/s vs MPC's 9.9 deg/s.

current_row.title: VGFM: Expressive Robot Policies via Dense Value Guidance in Flow Matching
current_row.one_line: Offline RL flow-matching policy with dense critic guidance at randomly sampled flow timesteps, avoiding BPTT through the flow; strong OGBench locomotion and manipulation results with minimal tuning (IROS 2026).

current_row.title: REVOLVE: An Automated Closed-Loop Framework for Evolving Robot Manipulation with Minimal Human Intervention
current_row.one_line: VLM failure monitoring, deterministic recovery and automatic resets reduce human intervention during iterative learning. On four real ViperX tasks, average success rises from 40.0% to 58.5% over five iterations; human help remains available.

current_row.title: ReWeight: Leveraging Human Data for VLA Post-Training via Demonstration Retrieval and Sample Weighting
current_row.one_line: Optimal-transport retrieval of egocentric human demos plus sample weighting for pi0.5 post-training; RoboTwin simulation success 39% robot-only to 57%, real-world 40.0% to 68.8%. Weighted BC, without RL.

current_row.title: When Validation Stops Learning: Auditing Update Admission for Continual Embodied Agents
current_row.one_line: Audits policy-update admission: paired-binomial checks admit 31.6% of updates at 2,000 episodes/stage versus zero for a range-based gate in synthetic pushing. Unconditional replay learns better closed-loop; evidence remains analytical and simulated.

current_row.title: HaWMPO: Hallucination-Aware World Model-based Policy Optimization for Generalist Robot Policy
current_row.org: JD Joy Future Academy; Jilin University
current_row.one_line: Action-conditioned model scores hallucination per imagined chunk (AUROC 0.9375 on 50 human-labeled LIBERO chunks); scores down-weight chunk rewards in GRPO. LIBERO Spatial/Goal/Object average 63.7 vs 60.9 for reproduced WoVR* (no PACE).

current_row.title: No Free Checker: A Survey of Verifiers for Robot Policies
current_row.one_line: A survey of roughly 150 robot verifiers grouped by who supplies the judgment; finds credibility falls as availability rises, and argues robotics has yet to search a learned verifier for inputs it wrongly accepts.

current_row.title: Proxy Policy Steering (PPS)
current_row.one_line: Nudges the base velocity field by gamma*(v_task - v_ref) from two small proxy models, with no RL. Real 8 tasks: pi0.5 22% → 79%, vs LoRA 59%, residual 19%, DSRL 25%.

current_row.title: Phase-and-First-Arrival VLM Feedback for Sparse-Reward Reinforcement Learning in Surgical Manipulation
current_row.short: Phase-and-First-Arrival VLM Feedback for Sparse-Reward Reinforcement Learning in…
current_row.one_line: VLM feedback returns the furthest visually verified task phase and its first-arrival time so sparse-reward RL reuses partial progress from failures; 75.2% vs 52.1% for CLIP rewards in simulation.

current_row.title: Noisy-Space Policy Gradient for Diffusion Policies in Offline Reinforcement Learning
current_row.short: Noisy-Space Policy Gradient for Diffusion Policies in Offline Reinforcement Learning
current_row.one_line: Defines a Q-function over diffusion latents and a noisy-space policy gradient that avoids backprop through denoising; improves offline RL on state-based D4RL and vision-based OGBench (ICML 2026).

current_row.title: VLA-Corrector: Stage-Aware Observable State Understanding for Prompt-Based Closed-Loop Recovery of Vision-Language-Action Policies
current_row.one_line: Learned verifier estimates stage-wise progress and risk from observations, proprioception and actions, triggering stage-conditioned recovery prompts for a frozen VLA; improves LIBERO/LIBERO-Plus robustness without parameter updates.

current_row.title: How to Learn from What a Human Would Avoid? Intervention-Aware World Models with Real-World RL for Dexterous Manipulation
current_row.org: HKUST (Guangzhou); Italian Institute of Technology; Zhejiang University
current_row.one_line: Real-world HIL residual SAC over a frozen BC prior; an intervention-aware latent world model predicts operator takeovers and shapes the actor away from them. Pick & Place: BC 43.3%, model-free HIL residual 60.0%, WHIRL 90.0% (30 trials).

current_row.title: Continual Field-Adaptive Models (CFAMs) for Post-Deployment Physical AI
current_row.one_line: Frozen slow model plus on-device Capsule Field memory adds verified near-OOD successes without gradients. Matches an in-house full-data policy using 40% of its data; memory growth raises mean action success from 74.0% to 87.9%.

current_row.title: R2S-Eval: Robot Evaluation with Real-to-Sim Calibration via Vision-Language Models
current_row.one_line: Calibrated Isaac twin plus pairwise VLM preferences with Bradley-Terry. Mean real-sim gap 2.13 pp and identical ranking across 6 VLAs.

current_row.title: WISE: World-model-guided Imagination Scheduling for Efficient Post-training of Vision-Language-Action Models
current_row.one_line: Imagines candidate chunks only at interaction-relevant states. Uses 77% less GPU time than full imagination and gets real pi0 60.0 → 77.5.

current_row.title: Harnessing human expertise for high-precision robotic assembly in industrialized construction: A sample-efficient installer-in-the-loop interactive reinforcement learning framework
current_row.short: Harnessing human expertise for high-precision robotic assembly in industrialized…
current_row.one_line: Installer-in-the-loop RL (Q-chunking with Flow Q-Learning, teleop demos plus binary takeovers) for window-unit seating, in MuJoCo sim: at 2 mm per-side clearance, 100% autonomous seating after 3.0 h online training with 12-15 min supervision.

current_row.title: Recursive Value Learning for Long-Horizon Offline Goal-Conditioned RL
current_row.one_line: DCRL: recursively splits trajectory segments into a balanced binary tree, cutting worst-case bootstrap depth from linear to logarithmic; on the five hardest long-horizon OGBench tasks, raises the best prior average score from 55 to 64.

current_row.title: Do Better Imagined Rollouts Mean Better Robot Control? A Controlled Study of World-Model Evaluation Under Feedback
current_row.short: Do Better Imagined Rollouts Mean Better Robot Control? A Controlled Study of…
current_row.one_line: Six state estimators on differential-drive path tracking, 24 sensing conditions: replay position RMSE predicts closed-loop cross-track error (Spearman 0.923) better than open-loop rollout error (0.774).

current_row.title: Knowing When to Stop: Adaptive Action Chunking via Internal Cross-Attention Dynamics in VLAs
current_row.one_line: Training-free adaptive execution horizon for VLAs: detects high-entropy plateaus in action-to-observation cross-attention to decide when to replan; improves success on RoboTwin 2.0 and LIBERO.

current_row.title: Towards Universal Post-Training for Robotics (blog)
current_row.one_line: Position essay for an EXPO-FT-style standard robot post-training recipe. It cites EXPO-FT reaching 30/30 with an average of about 19 min of online interaction. The baseline averages cover only the 4 tasks every baseline ran.

current_row.title: PAVE: Predictive Alignment and Value-Guided Evolution for World-Action Policies
current_row.one_line: Combines multi-horizon future-latent prediction with value-derived quality conditions for a flow actor. Matched-data comparisons improve success by 5.0 points on LIBERO-Plus and 4.5 points on RoboTwin Random (simulation).

current_row.title: Motus2: A Self-Evolving General World Model for Dexterous Manipulation
current_row.one_line: Single shared-weight model serves as policy, simulator and evaluator in a closed loop; curated expert demos train actions while failed and suboptimal interactions train dynamics and value; tactile sensing on a dexterous bimanual platform.

current_row.title: SmoothRL: Online Reinforcement Learning During Asynchronous Execution
current_row.one_line: Bounded residual TD3 actor on a frozen pi0.5 trained under the real asynchronous execution loop; tossing 39% → 94%, pen capping 8% → 83% over ~250 episodes.

current_row.title: DREAM: Deployment-Time Demonstration Generation via Real-to-Sim for Scalable Policy Adaptation
current_row.one_line: Reconstructs the deployment workspace in sim, translates instructions to symbolic goals via LLM, and uses TAMP to generate verified, randomized demos for VLA fine-tuning without human teleoperation.

current_row.title: FLARE: A Failure-Aware Framework for Autonomous Correction and Recovery in Visual-Language Robotic Manipulation
current_row.one_line: Retry via perturbation and bridging-segment augmented demos, plus Reset skills learned from offline MLLM failure-video analysis and gated by an online MLLM monitor, improves VLA robustness on contact-rich tasks.

current_row.title: Understanding Evolution Strategies for LLM Reasoning: Broader Reasoning Coverage than GRPO
current_row.short: Understanding Evolution Strategies for LLM Reasoning: Broader Reasoning Coverage than GRPO
current_row.one_line: Analyzes ES post-training for LLM reasoning: unlike GRPO (entropy collapse), ES improves Pass@1 and reaches higher Pass@K than GRPO; gains concentrate in a sparse subset of larger-magnitude parameter updates; tests sequential GRPO/ES combinations (adjacent, LLMs).

current_row.title: GRAFT: Grounded and Efficient Online Reinforcement Adaptation for Fine-Grained Robot Manipulation
current_row.one_line: ConRFT-style online VLA RL plus training-only visual anchors for fine-grained lab tasks; 82.5% vs 57.5% for proposal-union supervision.

current_row.title: R^3: Training Robots to Reason in Natural Language via Reinforcement Learning
current_row.one_line: Post-trains a VLM as a robotic reasoner: mid-training on expert reasoning traces, then rubric-based RL on offline action data; language reasoning steers low-level policies at test time.

current_row.title: Beyond Pairwise Feedback: Listwise Vision-Language Supervision for Preference-Based Reward Learning
current_row.one_line: A VLM ranks K=3-5 replay-buffer frames at once; a Plackett-Luce listwise loss trains the reward model. Competitive with pairwise Bradley-Terry and RL-VLM-F on three Meta-World tasks (Drawer Open: PL 86% vs RL-VLM-F 92%).

current_row.title: RoG-DAgger: Rollout-Guided Post-Training for End-to-End Driving
current_row.one_line: DAgger uses short-horizon kinematic rollouts to generate driving corrections and time takeovers. In CARLA, improves SimLingo by 5.3 driving-score points on Bench2Drive and raises Fail2Drive OOD success from 55% to 66%.

current_row.title: CounterAlign: Counterfactual Supervision for Vision-Language-Action Models
current_row.one_line: Pairs expert actions with mismatched instructions and trains an adversarial discriminator as a reward for offline-RL VLA post-training; improves LIBERO-PRO robustness and real-robot (TX-G2) results.

current_row.title: Decoupling Policy Extraction for Offline Reinforcement Learning
current_row.short: Decoupling Policy Extraction for Offline Reinforcement Learning
current_row.one_line: Trains the actor purely as a behavior model and does policy improvement at inference by critic reranking of behavior-supported candidates; reported to beat BC and jointly trained offline RL.

current_row.title: SCAPE: Scenario-Conditioned Simulation-Augmented Policy Evaluation
current_row.one_line: Predicts scenario-level real-world policy performance from few paired sim/real samples plus many sim rollouts, with sim-bias correction and conformal calibration. Sim-to-sim: error down 4.9%/34.7% (driving), 14.5%/27.7% (quadruped) vs neural/aggregate baselines; also run on a real Go2.

current_row.title: Dream2Reward: Transition-Alignment Reward Models from Positive Demonstrations for Robotic Manipulation
current_row.one_line: Learns reward from success-only demos by predicting expected transitions and scoring observed displacement on direction and magnitude agreement; penalizes wrong-direction and overshoot, reducing reward hacking in online/offline RL.

current_row.title: Fine-Tuning VLAs with Self-Demonstrated Generative Control for Multi-Task Manipulation
current_row.one_line: Replays frozen base-VLA rollouts with new expert demonstrations to prevent forgetting. Real ALOHA gear insertion: 30% with expert-only fine-tuning to 90% with self-demonstration replay.

current_row.title: Hydra-0: Action Flow for Generalist World Modeling and Control
current_row.one_line: Generalist world model conditioned on pixel action flow across embodiments; 90.4% lower robot-motion error than action-conditioned baseline, r=0.96 replayed-vs-reference success correlation on RoboLab.

current_row.title: Reuse Before You Retrieve: Diagnosing Headroom and Complementarity for Test-Time Augmentation of Embodied Multimodal Policies
current_row.one_line: Diagnoses frozen VLAs via recoverable headroom (resampling/retry selection) versus retrieval complementarity (external demos); gains up to 21 points on LIBERO track measured headroom.

current_row.title: ORPA: Online Residual Policy Adaptation for Robot Manipulation Control with Human Feedback
current_row.one_line: Supervised residual head that turns coarse human feedback ('too left') into joint corrections for a frozen ACT, with no RL. Sim induced-failure Cube Transfer 60.0% → 92.3%.

current_row.title: Prism-GRPO: Faster VLA Policy Optimization via Splitting Same-outcome Groups
current_row.one_line: Reward = success + 0.2*quality (contacts, jerk, VLM judge) to break zero-variance groups, with an RLOO advantage. Theory: binary GRPO needs ~1.76x the rollouts per informative group at G=8 (p=0.1/0.9).

current_row.title: Zetta ζ: An Efficient Closed-Loop Embodied Harness for Self-Evolving Physical Intelligence
current_row.one_line: Harness evolves runtime critics and recovery skills around frozen VLAs. Across 40 LIBERO-Pro Goal/Long task-settings, pi0.5 success rises from 32.0% to 71.1%; on 18 RoboCasa tasks, GR00T rises from 73.6% to 93.6%.

current_row.title: Le Critique: Privileged Value Functions for LLM Reinforcement Learning
current_row.one_line: Privileged value functions give critics information hidden from the policy; TETHER mixes value and group-relative baselines. Both improve over standard value baselines and are competitive with or outperform mean-baseline GRPO on tested reasoning tasks.

current_row.title: Q-Learning With World Models (QWM)
current_row.one_line: World-model tree search selects actions during online RL and evaluation atop EXPO/RLPD. Policy and Q-functions train only on real transitions; Robomimic and LIBERO experiments report improved sample efficiency from predictive search.

current_row.title: Max-Q Selective Imitation for Human-in-the-Loop Online Robot Learning (PDF subtitle: "with Monte Carlo Q-Chunk Critics")
current_row.one_line: A Monte Carlo chunk critic selects imitation targets from buffer or actor actions by Q. Real USB insertion: ACT QChunk-MCBC reaches 99% in 30 minutes; HIL-SERL peaks at 100% after 5 hours.

current_row.title: Ontology-Grounded World Models for Failure Diagnosis and Closed-Loop Repair in Physical AI Systems
current_row.one_line: Onto-EV-WM layers a task ontology and deterministic rules over the EV-WM world model to record unmet predicates and route verification-gated corrections. LIBERO-Goal replay windows: 86.95% to 94.05% after direct simulator-state corrections; PointMaze ties EV-WM at 94%.

current_row.title: PRM-as-a-Judge 1.5: A Toolkit for Robot Process Assessment
current_row.one_line: Evaluation toolkit that turns rollout videos into dense progress curves with three metrics (failure-side progress, recovery, success-side execution quality); adds RoboPulse++ to validate process reward models.

current_row.title: ContactGuard: Pre-Contact Execution Monitoring with Action-Conditioned Latent World Models
current_row.one_line: Action-conditioned latent world model trained on unlabeled trajectories predicts multi-view embeddings under planned actions; a lightweight failure probe aborts failure-prone actions before contact, without modifying the policy.

current_row.title: Self-Evolving Embodied Agents via Skill-Harness Evolution
current_row.short: Self-Evolving Embodied Agents via Skill-Harness Evolution
current_row.one_line: SHAPER: training-free self-improvement that keeps model weights frozen and evolves reusable skills plus a context-code harness; compared to fine-tuning and test-time scaling on VLABench and ESI-Bench. (adjacent)

current_row.title: Critic-Free Pretraining for Efficient Online Reinforcement Learning Fine-Tuning
current_row.one_line: Pretrains only a BC actor offline, then starts online fine-tuning with a fresh critic after a short warm-up on offline data; plugs into existing offline-to-online algorithms; gains on simulated OGBench manipulation, roughly on par on Robomimic.

current_row.title: verdi: retrieval is not transfer for continual world model optimization
current_row.one_line: Treats optimization strategies retrieved for world models (Ctrl-World, Cosmos family, RoboCoin adaptation) as hypotheses validated on-target by a frozen verifier: 68% lower search cost vs cold start, negative transfer 0.34 (unconditional reuse) to 0.06.

current_row.title: RefineFly: Failure-Aware Post-Training for Aerial Vision-Language Navigation
current_row.one_line: Token-level PPO post-training of a UAV VLA with dynamic failure memory, a two-stage scene curriculum and stage-specific reference regularization. TravelUAV (AirSim sim): +3.12 to 8.37 pp success over AerialVLA, with total rollouts about 30% of training-set size.

current_row.title: VANE: Reliable Test-Time Training for Vision-Language-Action Models via Future Visual Representation Prediction
current_row.one_line: Test-time prompt adaptation for VLAs: candidate updates are isolated, checked against future visual observations, and committed only if supported; +3.2 points over baseline TTT on SimplerEnv WidowX.

current_row.title: FACT: Failure-Aware Causal Training for World-Action Models
current_row.one_line: World-action model that predicts future video and task progress conditioned on executed actions, so failure rollouts supervise action consequences. Adding failure data lifts real bimanual seen-task success 82% to 89%; RoboTwin sim 87.5% vs Motus 87.8%.

current_row.title: Efficient Real-World Online Reinforcement Learning for Robot Manipulation via Centralized Training and Critic Decomposition (HARC: Hybrid Actors with Reward-decomposed Critic)
current_row.one_line: Separate arm and gripper actors with one reward-decomposed central critic; real 3-task average 40% → 75% vs HIL-SERL.

current_row.title: SpeedTuning: Speeding Up Policy Execution with Lightweight Reinforcement Learning
current_row.one_line: Rainbow DQN picks the playback speed of a frozen ACT's chunks, so it hill-climbs cycle time rather than success. Sim Cube Transfer runs 3.81x faster at 97.9% (ACT 100%). The arXiv date is 2026-08, but the venue is ICRA 2025.

current_row.title: AutoIntervene: Calibrated Intervention for Action-Chunking Imitation Learning Policies
current_row.one_line: Scores proposed action chunks by visual similarity and consistency against a memory of successful demos, with separate calibrated thresholds for policy-operator handoffs; corrections from successful rollouts adapt the policy.

current_row.title: Beyond Flat Policies: Hierarchical Post-Training for Embodied Agents in Robotic Manipulation (HiRoC)
current_row.one_line: Hierarchical post-training: a Qwen2.5-VL-3B planner emits subgoals; an OpenVLA-OFT executor is first aligned to planner subgoals, then improved with online GRPO. LIBERO average 93.5% vs 91.0% for the strongest listed baseline.

current_row.title: EvoHIL: Self-Evolving Reward and Flow-Matched Policy Optimization for Robust Human-in-the-Loop Reinforcement Learning
current_row.one_line: HIL-SERL-style RL with a self-evolving success classifier, flow-matching action-chunk actor, and offline fine-tuning on relit replay; real FR3 USB insertion at the 60% point of a composite lighting-shift index: 1.00 vs HIL-SERL 0.50.

current_row.title: Towards the Harness of Embodied Agents
current_row.short: Towards the Harness of Embodied Agents
current_row.org: Qi Wang, Wentao Zhu et al.
current_row.one_line: Thea brings the coding-agent harness to robots: a persistent scene graph serves as context, and evaluations act as exit codes that detect completion, judge success and diagnose failures on long-horizon tasks.

current_row.title: Why Does Action Chunking Improve Behavioral Cloning Performance in Robotic Control?
current_row.short: Why Does Action Chunking Improve Behavioral Cloning Performance in Robotic Control?
current_row.one_line: Experiments attribute action-chunking gains to non-Markovian expressivity, reduced compounding error and implicit ensembling over delays. An explicit delayed-policy ensemble outperforms chunking in many tested settings.

current_row.title: You Don't Need To Stay in The Loop: An Agentic Robotics Loop for Robot-Policy Improvement
current_row.short: You Don't Need To Stay in The Loop
current_row.one_line: LLM controller coordinates recoverable train-evaluate-improve runs. Hardened gates reduce false promotions to 0.001 per run versus 0.005–0.021 with shipped gates; on the one measured lineage, checkpoint selection loses to taking the last checkpoint.

current_row.title: RL Bootstrapping of OpenVLA-OFT for a Novel Robot Embodiment
current_row.short: RL Bootstrapping of OpenVLA-OFT for a Novel Robot Embodiment
current_row.one_line: Demo-free RL in simulation aligns OpenVLA-OFT to a cable-driven parallel robot: PPO on directional primitives, then GRPO with expanded instructions. Held-out directional success 34.25% (after PPO) to 53.50% (after GRPO); move-to-object only 9.75%.

current_row.title: WCM: A World Critic Model for Vision-Language-Action Reinforcement Learning
current_row.one_line: A history-aware critic trained with latent next-state prediction; beats a single-frame VLM critic on all 7 real RECAP/AWR tasks (best 44/50) and reaches 99.0% ManiSkill IND with OpenVLA-OFT (PPO critic: 97.7%).

current_row.title: RLMM-Flow: A Flow-based Mobile Manipulation Framework with Latent-Space Reinforcement Learning
current_row.one_line: Frozen pretrained flow policy steered by an offline-RL latent-noise actor, with action-critic warm-up and coarse-to-fine latent-to-residual expansion; beats imitation-only and RL post-training baselines on success and collisions in simulated mobile manipulation, transferred zero-shot to real.

current_row.title: RL2-VLA: Adaptive RL Latent Compositional Steering with Test-Time Scaling for Vision-Language-Action Models
current_row.one_line: Offline-RL head on VLA latents is blended into the velocity to diversify candidates for verifier best-of-N, gated by a SAFE failure detector. PolaRiS pi0.5 OOD average 14.3 → 42.7 (rephrase 31.8).

current_row.title: ViTacWorld: Scaling Visuo-Tactile World Models for Contact-Rich Robot Manipulation
current_row.one_line: Action-conditioned visuo-tactile world model trained on real plus simulated tactile data; predicts aligned vision and touch for policy evaluation and rollout-based data augmentation of tactile policies.

current_row.title: GRACE: Gradient-Free Robot Action Generation via Combined Diffusion-MPPI Posterior Mean Estimation
current_row.one_line: Steers pretrained diffusion policies using MPPI forward cost evaluations, including non-differentiable constraints. On a real 7-DoF arm, avoids a deployment-time obstacle that the unguided prior hits in every trial.

current_row.title: RoboHarness: Memory-Driven Orchestration of Heterogeneous Robot Policies for Long-Horizon Planning
current_row.org: Huawei Noah's Ark Lab; UBC; University of Toronto; McGill
current_row.one_line: Orchestrates heterogeneous policies (VLA, RL, TAMP) as agentic skills, using execution memory and a Memory Bridge to route and hand off between them; evaluated on 500 tasks and 135 real-robot trials.

current_row.title: Test-Time Scaling for World Action Models via Zero-Shot Geometric Evaluation
current_row.short: Test-Time Scaling for World Action Models via Zero-Shot Geometric Evaluation
current_row.one_line: Training-free best-of-N ranks world-action-model futures by cross-view depth-reprojection consistency from a frozen geometry model. At N=8, RoboCasa simulation group averages rise from 66.3% to 68.4% for Cosmos Policy and 80.8% to 82.5% for X-WAM.

current_row.title: Data and Learning Where it Matters for Contact-Rich Manipulation
current_row.one_line: Motion planning for free-space motion; autonomous dense data collection plus offline SAC-based RL only for the contact segment; real 4-task average 96% vs 55% for the strongest baseline.

current_row.title: RoboTTT: Context Scaling for Robot Policies
current_row.one_line: Fast-weight test-time training compresses history into weights, scaling visuomotor context to 8K timesteps. Real-robot average task-completion score: 79% versus single-step GR00T N1.7 at 42% and strongest baseline GDN at 56%.

current_row.title: DriftWorld: Fast World Modeling through Drifting
current_row.one_line: Action-conditioned drifting world model generating future frames in one forward pass: 30+ fps, 17x faster on average than diffusion baselines; policy-ranking scores correlate with simulator ground truth up to 0.99 (Robomimic Lift).

current_row.title: Zero2Skill: Bootstrapping Robot Skills through Autonomous Data Collection, Training, and Deployment
current_row.one_line: Language corrections persist in a corrective memory for autonomous data collection. Matches teleoperation episode-collection success at 16% of human working time; separately, two corrections raise real single-attempt collection success from 12.5% to 47.5%.

current_row.title: Never Too Late for Force: Accelerating VLA Post-Training with Reactive Force Injection (LIFT)
current_row.org: Shanghai Jiao Tong University; Shanghai Innovation…
current_row.one_line: Grafts force sensing onto pi0.5 during online DAgger; towel folding peaked at 0.825 (#2.8K frames) vs vision-only 0.725 (#3.1K).

current_row.title: Deconstructing Actor-Critic: A Large-scale Empirical Study of Design Components for Practitioners
current_row.one_line: 33,000+ experiments on a simulated PID-gain-tuning task built from real water-treatment-plant data dissect actor-critic design choices; Gaussian policies with pathwise gradients are among the least reliable, bounded distributions with adaptive update schedules stay robust.

current_row.title: DenseReward: Dense Reward Learning via Failure Synthesis for Robotic Manipulation
current_row.org: UNC Chapel Hill, CMU, SJTU, Amazon
current_row.one_line: Failures synthesized in sim train a Qwen3-VL-4B progress model (MAE 0.081 vs 0.230 for RoboReward-8B); real DSRL stack cups 60% sparse to 80% (10 trials).

current_row.title: UR-VC: Unsupervised Robotic Value Correction for Time-Derived Progress Proxies
current_row.one_line: Training-free correction of t/T labels via cross-episode nearest neighbours; advantage-conditioned cloth folding 72.8% (131/180) to 78.9% (142/180), vs a no-advantage baseline.

current_row.title: VINE: Taming Generative Control Policies for Reinforcement Learning
current_row.one_line: Replaces the Euler sampler so direct Q-gradients through a flow policy stay stable; OGBench 40 tasks 60 vs QAM 55.

current_row.title: Learning More from Less: Reinforcement Learning from Hindsight (LfH)
current_row.one_line: A VLM relabels low-reward GRPO groups (mean reward <0.8) with a hindsight instruction and reward. LIBERO-PRO OOD: matches GRPO's final score in ~5 vs ~30 steps. Real Franka FR3: 56% vs GRPO's 22% at 160 rollouts.

current_row.title: Harness VLA: Steering Frozen VLAs into Reliable Manipulation Primitives via Memory-Guided Agents
current_row.one_line: LLM coding agents compose a frozen VLA with analytic primitives, learning operating ranges from execution traces. Best planner backend versus frozen VLA alone: LIBERO-Pro 82.4% versus 50.0%; RoboCasa365 57.1% versus 30.0% (simulation).

current_row.title: WAM-TTT: Steering World-Action Models by Watching Human Play at Test Time
current_row.one_line: Test-time training updates a lightweight adaptive memory inside a frozen world-action model via self-supervised prediction on unlabeled human videos; beats in-context human-video conditioning on manipulation tasks.

current_row.title: Reward-Aware Population Scaling of Evolutionary Strategies in LLM Fine-Tuning
current_row.short: Reward-Aware Population Scaling of Evolutionary Strategies in LLM Fine-Tuning
current_row.one_line: In tested capable 0.5B–7B LLMs, z-score normalization can make binary-reward ES with N=2 fail; removing it improves GSM8K/TREC results. Derives zero-advantage probability and cautions that N=2 is not universally sufficient.

current_row.title: PriGo: Test-Time Primitive Guidance to Diffusion and Flow Policies for Adaptive Robotic Manipulation
current_row.one_line: Lightweight PANet predicts motion primitives and applies differentiable guidance to pretrained diffusion/flow policies at inference, no retraining; gains on LIBERO, CALVIN, SIMPLER and real-robot tasks.

current_row.title: RoboSnap: One-Shot Real-to-Sim Scene Generation for Generalizable Robot Learning and Evaluation
current_row.one_line: Single RGB image to sim-ready scene (collision-aware foreground assets, 3DGS background); releases DROID-Sim from 564 real scenes for replay, synthetic data generation and sim-real correlated policy evaluation.

current_row.title: LAMP: Latent Motion Prior-Guided Real-World Learning for Dexterous Hand Manipulation
current_row.one_line: Residual SAC/RLPD in a 2-D learned latent of hand motions for a 6-DoF dexterous hand. Real average 56.25% → 98.75%, while the same residual RL in the raw action space fails.

current_row.title: Optimal Transport Q-Learning for Flow Policy Steering and Acceleration (OTQL)
current_row.org: University of Edinburgh; Honda Research Institute Europe
current_row.one_line: Advantage-weighted optimal-transport pairing in flow matching; OGBench 0.59 at 2 function evaluations vs QAM 0.55, real single-task 36% → 86%.

current_row.title: Leveraging Offline Supervision for Efficient and Generalizable Reinforcement Learning in Large-Scale Vision-Language-Action Models
current_row.one_line: PPO plus an annealed KL to a frozen SFT policy. At 1M steps it matches plain PPO at 2M (IND 0.93, OOD 0.77) and beats SFT warm-start and a BC loss.

current_row.title: VLA Grounder: Language-Conditioning Space Optimization for Black-Box VLA Models
current_row.one_line: GRPO trains a Qwen3.5-9B instruction rewriter around frozen pi0/OpenVLA, once per episode. VL-Think success: pi0 12.6% to 38.7%; OpenVLA with the grounder 63.9% versus GEPA’s 55.2%.

current_row.title: HALO-WA: Hybrid-Attention Latent-Guided Online Reinforcement Learning for World-Action Models
current_row.one_line: Small TD3 adapter on a frozen world-action model reads its latents and proposed chunk; real average 26.4% → 87.1%.

current_row.title: OmniTacTune: Policy-Agnostic Real-World RL for Tactile Residual Adaptation of Visual Policies
current_row.one_line: GelSight tactile SAC residual with a scheduled scale (0.05 → 0.15) on a frozen visual policy. Real base 40/10/5/5% → 100/100/90/85% after 40-80 min, including a 12-minute warm-start.

current_row.title: Look Before You Leap: Distilling Tree Search into Action Evaluation for Frozen VLA Models (SVA: Search, Value, and Act)
current_row.one_line: Distills simulator MCTS returns into a Q-model selecting candidates from a frozen VLA. Across five backbones, EmbodiedBench simulation success improves by 15.4 points on EB-Habitat and 13.2 on EB-Navigation over the base policies.

current_row.title: TACO: TActile World Model as a Self-COrrector for Scalable Robot Policy Post-Training
current_row.one_line: Visuo-tactile world model imagines corrections at stalled states. Average task score 0.375 → 0.825 vs DreamGen 0.550.

current_row.title: DREAMSTEER: Latent World Models Can Steer VLA Policies During Deployment Without Any Finetuning
current_row.one_line: DINOv2-space world model plus progress critic picks among pi0 samples and fixed motion primitives. Real OOD objects 23.75% → 66.25% (42.50% with policy samples only).

current_row.title: Rank-Then-Act: Reward-Free Control from Frame-Order Progress
current_row.one_line: A GRPO-trained VLM ranks shuffled frames and the reward is rank agreement; games and sim only (Catrap L2 1.00 vs GVL 0.47).

current_row.title: GigaWorld-1: A Roadmap to Build World Models for Robot Policy Evaluation
current_row.one_line: Benchmark (WMBench) and roadmap for world-model policy evaluators: 324k world-model rollout segments chained into human-scored episodes. Long-horizon action faithfulness and memory matter; background and photometric consistency correlate negatively with human scores.

current_row.title: Guided Action Flow: Q-Guided Inference for Flow-Matching Vision-Language-Action Policies
current_row.one_line: IQL critic on 100 logged rollouts of a frozen SmolVLA guides the flow sampler. Real bottle-to-box 19/40 → 34/40; no other baselines.

current_row.title: Stage-Transition Dense Reward Modeling for Reinforcement Learning
current_row.one_line: STDR learns visual dense rewards from expert videos: stage-transition plus within-stage progress signals, with OOD detection and grasp regulation; beats LIV/VIP on all 14 sim manipulation tasks and matches or beats handcrafted dense rewards on several.

current_row.title: ELASTIC: Efficiently Learning to Adaptively Scale Test-Time Compute for Generative Control Policies
current_row.one_line: SAC allocates denoising steps and samples per state. Real pi0.5 matches Best-of-10 with 34% lower latency; a fixed schedule derived from its learned allocation also matches, while adaptation wins at a smaller budget.

current_row.title: Z-1: Efficient Reinforcement Learning for Vision-Language-Action Models
current_row.one_line: GRPO on pi0.5 where each group branches from one cloned approach-phase state, so credit lands on the manipulation phase. RoboCasa 24 tasks 67.4 → 80.6. TurnOnSinkFaucet 29.2 → 98.4.

current_row.title: ReGuide: From Test-Time Guidance to Self-Improving Diffusion Policies
current_row.one_line: Phase-gated latent-dynamics guidance at test time, with the successes distilled back through filtered BC. Tool Hang 0.0312 → 0.2404 after two iterations (sim).

current_row.title: SimFoundry: Modular and Automated Scene Generation for Policy Learning and Evaluation
current_row.one_line: Reconstructs video-to-sim digital twins and affordance-preserving object, scene and task variants for policy training. Across seven manipulation tasks and five policies, simulated evaluations correlate with real performance (mean Pearson 0.911).

current_row.title: WARP-RM: A Warp-Augmented Relative Progress Reward Model for Data Curation
current_row.one_line: Self-supervised relative-progress reward model trained on time-warped (speed-varied, reversed) demos; used to filter/reweight BC action chunks, giving up to ~18x successful T-shirt-folding throughput over vanilla BC on a real bimanual robot.

current_row.title: World Action Models Enable Continual Imitation Learning with Recurrent Generative Replays
current_row.one_line: REGEN: a world action model generates synthetic replay trajectories from instructions and observations, cutting catastrophic forgetting up to 50% vs sequential fine-tuning without storing demos.

current_row.title: E-TTS: A New Embodied Test-Time Scaling Framework for Robotic Manipulation
current_row.one_line: Joint sampling of reasoning traces and actions scored by reasoning and action verifiers, with critique-and-resample. Real MolmoAct 22.13% → 48.75%; sim E-CoT 6.67 → 39.81 vs naive best-of-N 23.61.

current_row.title: Learning to Fold: prizewinning solution at LeHome Challenge 2026 (1st place online, 2nd offline)
current_row.one_line: AWR sampling, RECAP conditioning and CFG improve a simulated bimanual SO-ARM101 policy that also predicts value: 79.63%, first of 62 teams. The second-place real final instead uses plain BC.

current_row.title: Play2Perfect: What Matters in Dexterous Play Pretraining for Precise Assembly?
current_row.one_line: Two-stage RL for multi-fingered hands: task-agnostic play pretraining on diverse objects, then sparse-reward assembly fine-tuning; 33x more sample-efficient than RL from scratch (even with dense rewards); zero-shot real 60% (6/10) on 0.5 mm-clearance insertions.

current_row.title: RMTL: Reinforced Micro-task Learning for Long-Horizon Manipulation with VLM Rewards
current_row.one_line: Splits long-horizon tasks into language-described micro-tasks, computing multi-view VLM rewards per active micro-task with hierarchical RL and reverse curriculum; faster learning than single-prompt VLM rewards on Fetch.

current_row.title: ROAD-VLA: Robust Online Adaptation via Self-Distillation for Vision-Language-Action Models
current_row.one_line: Replaces PPO's policy loss with distillation to a closed-form, token-level advantage-tilted teacher. OOD 69+/-4 → 73+/-4 vs PPO, but not better on every ID cell, and 40.8 h vs 25.4 h compute.

current_row.title: FORCE: Efficient VLA Reinforcement Fine-Tuning via Value-Calibrated Warm-up and Self-Distillation
current_row.one_line: ConRFT-style Cal-QL + consistency-policy recipe without human interventions, adding an on-policy value-calibration warm-up and value-filtered self-distillation; ManiSkill 6-task sim average FORCE (Octo) 82.3% vs ConRFT without human intervention 71.1%.

current_row.title: Beyond Monotonic Progress: Retry-Supervised Value Learning for Robot Imitation
current_row.one_line: ReTVL treats retry events in imperfect demos as supervision, combining global progress calibration with local pairwise preferences to learn a non-monotonic value model that reweights demonstration segments for BC.

current_row.title: World Value Models for Robotic Manipulation
current_row.short: World Value Models for Robotic Manipulation
current_row.one_line: World Value Model: uses a world model rather than a VLM for value estimation; SOTA Value-Order Correlation, adds Suboptimal-Value-Bench (800 annotated suboptimal trajectories), improves sim and real policy learning.

current_row.title: dVLA-RL: Reinforcement Learning over Denoising Trajectories for Discrete Diffusion Vision-Language-Action Models
current_row.one_line: RL fine-tuning for discrete-diffusion VLAs: treats denoising as an MDP and optimizes the sampled path's joint probability; 99.7% on LIBERO, and 61.4% → 92.0% over its SFT backbone on eight RoboTwin 2.0 tasks.

current_row.title: Robot Self-Improvement via Human-Video Dynamics Models
current_row.org: ETH Zurich; TU Munich; Microsoft; MCML
current_row.one_line: Human-video dynamics plus value models relabel failed states with better actions. Stretch average 85.3% vs RISE 76.0%; pi0.5 62.7 → 88.0.

current_row.title: Robot Critics that Sweat the Small Stuff
current_row.short: Robot Critics that Sweat the Small Stuff
current_row.one_line: Fine-tunes a Qwen2.5-VL pairwise progress critic from policy success/failure rollouts (binary labels) to pick among video-model-predicted outcomes of sampled actions. Real diffusion policy: Stacking 23/50 → 32/50, Push-Bowl mIoU 0.140 → 0.321.

current_row.title: Temporal Self-Imitation Learning
current_row.one_line: TSIL mines fast successful RL trajectories into adaptive temporal targets and efficiency-weighted self-imitation, improving success, speed and robustness on 30 long-horizon manipulation and navigation tasks.

current_row.title: Reward as An Agent for Embodied World Models
current_row.short: Reward as An Agent for Embodied World Models
current_row.one_line: Agentic Qwen3.5 reward that checks planning, visual quality, instruction following, physics and task completion, plus DynDiff-GRPO rollout diversification, for RL post-training of robot video world models; PAI-Bench robot Domain score +0.80 (Cosmos-Predict2.5-2B), +3.08 (Kairos-3.0-Robot).

current_row.title: SC3-Eval: Evaluating Robot Foundation Models via Self-Consistent Video Generation
current_row.one_line: Video-model policy evaluator enforcing forward-inverse dynamics, cross-view and test-time consistency; 0.929 closed-loop Pearson and 0.119 MMRV across seven real-world VLA policies.

current_row.title: Mem-World: Memory-Augmented Action-Conditioned World Models for Persistent Robot Manipulation
current_row.one_line: 4D wrist-view surfel-indexed memory for action-conditioned world models; +14.5% Pearson correlation with real performance over Ctrl-World, and synthetic data lifts long-horizon success 58% to 72%.

current_row.title: DF-ExpEnse: Diffusion Filtered Exploration for Sample Efficient Finetuning
current_row.one_line: Explores diffusion-policy candidates with critic min-value plus disagreement: three policy samples and one base sample, with ten critics (DSRL normally uses two). Reports sample-efficiency gains on simulated RoboMimic and OpenAI Gym tasks.

current_row.title: Object-Centric Residual RL for Zero-Shot Sim-to-Real VLA Enhancement
current_row.one_line: TD3 residual on 6-DoF object poses, proprioception and the base action, trained only in a simple MuJoCo scene (measured primitives) against a paired 'sim VLA'. Real GR00T-N1.5 five-task average goes from 42% to 76% with zero real-world RL.

current_row.title: Recover, Discover, Plan: Learning Skills and Concepts from Robot Failures
current_row.one_line: ReSYNC learns RL recovery skills and discovers relational predicates from them to refine an abstract planner; outperforms evaluated baselines on unseen long-horizon tasks across four simulation domains, with a real-robot sim-to-real demonstration.

current_row.title: WAM-RL: World-Action Model Reinforcement Learning with Reconstruction Rewards and Online Video SFT
current_row.one_line: Online RL for world-action models that jointly optimizes world and action branches via environment interaction; actor-only tuning helps short-horizon tasks, joint optimization is needed for long-horizon gains.

current_row.title: Visual Verification Enables Inference-time Steering and Autonomous Policy Improvement (VERITAS)
current_row.one_line: Gradient-free verifier scores sampled π0 action chunks by distance to a Gemini-drawn 2D end-effector trace; verified successes are distilled back by BC. Reported average steering gains: 12.6% sim, 35% real; BC fine-tuning +9.7% over π0-Bridge in sim.

current_row.title: Steering Generative Reinforcement Learning into Stable Robotic Controller (SteerGenPO)
current_row.one_line: Replaces stochastic latent sampling of a trained generative RL policy with a learned state-dependent latent actor for deterministic deployment; beats baselines on six Isaac Lab tasks plus Unitree G1 locomotion.

current_row.title: Hierarchical Advantage Weighting for Online RL Fine-Tuning of VLAs from Sparse Episode Outcomes (HABC: Hierarchical Advantage-Weighted Behavior Cloning)
current_row.one_line: Viability and efficiency critic heads turn episode success bits into per-transition flow-matching weights. At equal budget, SFT 36/44/12% → 60/78/22%.

current_row.title: SafeDojo: Safe Reinforcement Learning for VLA via Interactive World Model
current_row.org: Peking University; Beijing Innovation Center of Humanoid Robotics; NTU; HKUST; UESTC
current_row.one_line: Lagrangian-constrained GRPO inside a Wan 2.2-based video world model, with a learned per-step safety-cost head. Real Franka (5 tasks, 10 trials each): safe-success 70% vs 36% for the best baseline (SafeVLA), 22% for WoVR.

current_row.title: Inference-time Policy Steering via Vision and Touch (ViTaL)
current_row.one_line: Vision picks the mode (latent world model plus VLM reward), then tactile-reward-guided diffusion editing refines contact. Real, visual base policy (appendix): wiping 30 → 90%, pipette 30 → 75%, insertion 40 → 80%.

current_row.title: EV-WM: Event-Verified World Models for Long-Horizon Robotic Manipulation
current_row.one_line: Decodes imagined futures from a pretrained-feature world model into predicate-level event states and scores task progress, semantic consistency, physical feasibility and uncertainty to guide CEM planning. PointMaze random-target success 0.90 → 0.94 (simulation only).

current_row.title: WEAVER, Better, Faster, Longer: An Effective World Model for Robotic Manipulation
current_row.one_line: Multi-view flow-matching world model predicting future latents and rewards: 0.870 correlation with real success for policy evaluation, +38% real success over a foundation policy, +14% from 5-10x faster test-time planning.

current_row.title: Improving Robotic Generalist Policies via Flow Reversal Steering (FRS)
current_row.one_line: Flow-reverses coarse human or VLM hints into noise for a frozen pi0.5, then trains a noise-space BC/RL policy. Real DROID ~20% → ~87% zero-shot with human steering. Towel hanging 5% → 50% → 80% after RL.

current_row.title: Learning What to Say to Your VLA: Mostly Harmless Vision Language Action Model Steering
current_row.short: Learning What to Say to Your VLA
current_row.one_line: Searches for language instructions that raise a frozen VLA's closed-loop success, distills them into a language feedback policy, and uses a conformalized improvement head to refuse harmful steering; tested with pi0.5 on LIBERO-OOD and a real Franka.

current_row.title: VeriSpace: Spatially Grounded Action Verification for Vision-Language-Action Models
current_row.one_line: 3D-aware 7B verifier over k=8 VLA samples. SimplerEnv OpenVLA 37.0 → 55.0 vs RoboMonkey 40.5, V-GPS 36.0, MG-Select 39.0.

current_row.title: ReCoVLA: VLM-Guided Reward Compilation for Failure Recovery in Vision-Language-Action Policies
current_row.one_line: Frozen VLA plus residual recovery policies trained in sim with VLM-selected structured reward masks; sim success 36.7% (fine-tuned pi0.5) to 66.7%, 61.7% zero-shot sim-to-real.

current_row.title: DexPIE: Stable Dexterous Policy Improvement from Real-World Experience
current_row.one_line: One RECAP round with a continuous sigmoid optimality indicator on a dexterous diffusion policy. Average 50.0 BC / 75.3 HG-DAgger / 80.0 RECAP / 87.3% (50 trials per task).

current_row.title: TORL-VLA: Tactile Guided Online Reinforcement Learning for Contact-Rich Manipulation
current_row.one_line: Frozen wrench-aware pi0.5 plus small per-contact-phase actor-critics; full-task 12/30 (pi0.5) and 21/30 (reference) → 28/30.

current_row.title: ActProbe: Action-Space Probe for Early Failure Detection of Generative Robot Policies
current_row.one_line: Black-box failure detector using temporal consistency error between action chunks and chunk magnitude; +12.7% hypervolume, +9.0% early-detection ROC-AUC on unseen tasks, 2.9x fewer RL fine-tuning interactions.

current_row.title: Q-VGM: Q-Guided Value-Gradient Matching for Offline-to-Online RL of Flow-Matching VLA Policies
current_row.org: Shanghai Jiao Tong University; University of Michigan
current_row.one_line: Value-gradient matching at late pi0.5 denoising steps avoids BPTT; LIBERO few-shot-SFT mean 84.6% becomes 90.7% offline and 98.4% after online training.

current_row.title: Depth over Fidelity in Fixed-Budget Noisy Evolution Strategies
current_row.short: Depth over Fidelity in Fixed-Budget Noisy Evolution Strategies
current_row.one_line: Probabilistic elite membership (PEM) replaces hard ES rank weights with expected weights under ranking uncertainty. Residual-bootstrap RB-PEM improves COCO bbob-noisy, policy-search and hyperparameter-optimization results in tested noisy, fixed-budget settings.

current_row.title: Potential-Guided Flow Matching for Vision-Language-Action Policy Improvement (ForesightFlow)
current_row.one_line: The VLA generates a success-potential channel used both as the AWR baseline and for best-of-K selection. Real average 35.4% vs IDQL 32.6% vs filtered BC 24.6%.

current_row.title: Preference-Calibrated Human-in-the-Loop Reinforcement Learning for Robotic Manipulation (PACT: Preference-calibrated Actor-Critic Training)
current_row.one_line: Treats each human takeover as a preference to deflate credit for pre-takeover actions; average 58.0 → 82.5 vs HIL-SERL on 5 real tasks.

current_row.title: Set-Supervised Diffusion Policy: Learning Action-Chunking Diffusion through Corrections (SDP)
current_row.one_line: Uses the robot's rejected chunk to build a 'desired set' around the correction; robust to noisy corrections (noisy Square 0.946 vs DP 0.683).

current_row.title: Coherent Off-Policy Improvement of Large Behavior Models with Learned Rewards (CSIL++)
current_row.one_line: Dense coherent reward from a small BC policy avoids the fine-tuning dip on a frozen pi0.5; Threading 0.14 → 0.92 in sim, Nut Assembly no gain.

current_row.title: τ0-WM: A Unified Video-Action World Model for Robotic Manipulation
current_row.one_line: Unified video-action predictor plus action-conditioned simulator that scores candidate actions by task progress; trained on ~27,300 hours of teleop, UMI, egocentric human video and rollout/failure data.

current_row.title: FLAG: Flow Policy MaxEnt-RL by Latent Augmented Guidance
current_row.one_line: MaxEnt RL for flow policies: augments the state with a flow latent to localize importance sampling, mitigating weight collapse via a provably consistent proxy objective; scales to high-dimensional control (DMC, MyoSuite, MuJoCo).

current_row.title: Feat2Go: Visual Feature-Grounded Value Estimation for Embodied Reinforcement Learning
current_row.one_line: Value model trained on progress targets from world-model patch similarity to subgoals reshapes terminal rewards for PPO/GRPO VLA fine-tuning; ManiSkill3 (sim) average OOD success 82.9% vs 76.8% for OpenVLA-OFT with plain PPO and 17.5% after SFT.

current_row.title: HOIST: Humanoid Optimization with Imitation and Sample-efficient Tuning for Manipulating Suspended Loads
current_row.one_line: Noise-space RL adapts GR00T N1.6 for suspended-load pushing. Sim placement error: 22.44cm to 2.54cm after 20 rollouts, 6.25cm after 30. Real error: 9.28cm to 6.38cm; yaw worsens from 14.5° to 28.9°.

current_row.title: VE2VF: Vision-Enabled to Vision-Free Distillation via Real-world Reinforcement Learning for Robust Contact-Rich Manipulation
current_row.one_line: HIL-SERL-style vision teacher distilled into a vision-free student via real RL; 95.0% overall vs residual RL 85.7% in about 50 min.

current_row.title: Sample-Efficient Diffusion-based Reinforcement Learning with Critic Guidance (CGPO: Critic-Guided diffusion Policy Optimization)
current_row.one_line: Critic-guided diffusion sampling distilled back with advantage-weighted denoising; best on 5/5 MuJoCo tasks.

current_row.title: BORA: Bridging Offline Reinforcement Learning and Online Residual Adaptation for Real-World Dexterous VLA Models
current_row.org: SJTU, CASIA, Shanghai AI Lab, USTC
current_row.one_line: Offline IQL-style chunk critic on a consistency-head dexterous VLA, then a small online residual; real average 53.0% → 86.0%.

current_row.title: SPAR: Support-Preserving Action Rectification
current_row.one_line: Offline policy improvement as local residual rectification on a frozen BC policy; Latent Self-Imitation (latent weighted regression) avoids manifold-normal drift of value gradients; SOTA on D4RL.

current_row.title: ProgVLA: Progress-Aware Robot Manipulation Skill Learning
current_row.one_line: Compact 0.1B VLA with two-stage Perceiver resampling and jointly trained progress heads (offline-RL critics over normalized remaining-horizon targets) that weight flow-matching imitation; beats imported larger-baseline scores on LIBERO and Meta-World; progress weighting adds 2.3 points on LIBERO.

current_row.title: How VLAs Fail Differently: Black-Box Action Monitoring Reveals Architecture-Specific Failure Signatures
current_row.one_line: 450 PushT/ALOHA episodes across VQ-BeT, Diffusion Policy, ACT: action direction reversals predict failure (AUROC 0.79-0.93), velocity violations barely do; training-free SafeContract monitor with conformal calibration.

current_row.title: VR-DAgger: Immersive VR for Dexterous Data Collection and Uncertainty-Guided On-Policy Correction
current_row.one_line: MC-dropout uncertainty picks 2 s failure clips from Isaac Lab rollouts for VR correction; success comparable to unguided HITL review at about 40% less collection time per sample, up to +23 pp over BC (sim).

current_row.title: Scaling World-Model Reinforcement Learning Through Diffusion Policy Optimization
current_row.one_line: Replaces MPPI search with diffusion policy optimization anchored by an implicit energy/KL term. Competitive or better online across 121 simulated tasks; offline scaling generally helps, but both methods decline at 340M parameters on the 30-task dataset.

current_row.title: TapSampling: Inference-Time Sampling with a Task-Progress-Understanding Verifier for Robotic Manipulation
current_row.one_line: Action-VAE posterior turns a policy's actions into extra latent candidates; a task-progress verifier drops low scorers and score-weights the rest. CALVIN ABC→D avg length DP 2.41 → 2.58, OpenVLA 3.30 → 3.51; real π0 78.3% → 83.3%.

current_row.title: Beyond Action Residuals: Real-World Robot Policy Steering via Bottleneck Latent Reinforcement Learning (ZPRL, Z-Perturbation RL)
current_row.one_line: SAC perturbs a small variational-bottleneck latent inside a frozen flow policy rather than its actions. Real tasks gain 33.7% on average over the IL base (Insert Bills 20% → 77.5%), with about 28.5 h of real RL in total.

current_row.title: Contrastive Conceptor Activation Steering (COAST): Unlocking Vision-Language-Action Models through Hidden States
current_row.one_line: Training-free steering of a frozen policy's action-expert activations with contrastive conceptors fit from about 15 success/failure rollouts per task. Mean success up over 20 points in sim (partly early, under-trained checkpoints) and 40 points on 3 real tasks.

current_row.title: Hand-in-the-Loop: Improving VLA Policies for Dexterous Manipulation via Seamless Hand-Arm Intervention (HandITL)
current_row.one_line: Shared hand-arm corrections for a 56-DoF bimanual VLA with two 21-DoF hands; one hour of Copilot-mode correction data raises mean normalized subgoal score from about 0.70 to 0.95 across three real tasks.

current_row.title: RoboEvolve: Co-Evolving Planner-Simulator for Robotic Manipulation with Limited Data
current_row.one_line: VLM planner and video simulator co-evolve via GRPO exploration and near-miss preference mining. Planner gains 36.4/24.6 points over base Qwen3-VL on EB-ALFRED/EB-Habitat; simulator gains ~48% relative Gemini-judged task success on BridgeData V2.

current_row.title: D-VLA: A High-Concurrency Distributed Asynchronous Reinforcement Learning Framework for Vision-Language-Action Models
current_row.one_line: Distributed async RL system for large VLAs: decouples data and weight traffic, four-thread swimlane pipeline, dual-pool VRAM management; higher throughput than RLinf and RL-VLA3 for pi0.5 and OpenVLA-OFT in ManiSkill (16 GPUs).

current_row.title: DreamAvoid: Critical-Phase Test-Time Dreaming to Avoid Failures in VLA Policies
current_row.one_line: Test-time framework for VLAs: a trigger detects critical phases, a proposer samples alternative action chunks, and an evaluator trained on success/failure/boundary data dreams futures to pick one; four real tasks average 72.5% vs 48.8% for base π0.5.

current_row.title: Think Twice, Act Once: Verifier-Guided Action Selection For Embodied Agents
current_row.one_line: VeGAS: MLLM embodied agent samples multiple candidate actions and a verifier trained on LLM-synthesized failure cases picks one; up to 36% relative gain over CoT baselines on Habitat and ALFRED.

current_row.title: Discrete Flow Matching for Offline-to-Online Reinforcement Learning
current_row.short: Discrete Flow Matching for Offline-to-Online Reinforcement Learning
current_row.one_line: DRIFT: fine-tunes an offline-pretrained CTMC policy online with advantage-weighted discrete flow matching, a path-space penalty and candidate-set approximation; best on Jericho text games, not robotics.

current_row.title: TMRL: Diffusion Timestep-Modulated Pretraining Enables Exploration for Efficient Policy Finetuning
current_row.one_line: Context-smoothed pretraining plus a learned noise-level dial lets steering leave the base's narrow support. Real widowx-sausage reaches 1.0 at about 50 episodes while DSRL stays at 0 (RSS 2026).

current_row.title: Reinforce Adjoint Matching: Scaling RL Post-Training of Diffusion and Flow-Matching Models (adjacent)
current_row.one_line: RAM: reward-corrected pretraining target with a consistency loss, no SDE rollouts or backward adjoint sweeps; matches Flow-GRPO peak reward on SD3.5-M in up to 50x fewer steps. Image generation only.

current_row.title: Adaptive Action Chunking via Multi-Chunk Q Value Estimation (ACH)
current_row.one_line: Causal-transformer critic scores every chunk prefix so the chunk length is picked per state; puzzle-4x4 13 → 90 vs QC 11 → 38.

current_row.title: Retrieve-then-Steer: Online Success Memory for Test-Time Adaptation of Generative VLAs
current_row.org: Xi'an Jiaotong University; One Robotics; Shenzhen University of Advanced Technology
current_row.one_line: Stores progress-calibrated successful segments during deployment, retrieves and consistency-filters them into an elite action prior, and injects it into a frozen VLA's action sampler with confidence-adaptive strength. LIBERO-10: pi0.5 92.4% → 94.4%, pi0 81.6% → 84.4%; no weight updates.

current_row.title: Is the Future Compatible? Diagnosing Dynamic Consistency in World Action Models
current_row.short: Is the Future Compatible? Diagnosing Dynamic Consistency in World Action Models
current_row.one_line: Diagnoses action-state consistency in World Action Models and uses a value-free consensus over sampled futures for test-time selection; improves RoboCasa and RoboTwin 2.0 without extra training or reward models.

current_row.title: Failing Forward: Adaptive Failure-Informed Learning for Vision-Language-Action Models
current_row.one_line: A failure action head sharing the VLA backbone gives adaptive CFG-style negative guidance during sampling. LIBERO average pi0.5 96.9% → 98.4% (sim only).

current_row.title: Adaptive Q-Chunking for Offline-to-Online Reinforcement Learning (AQC)
current_row.org: Peking University; Galbot; University of Toronto
current_row.one_line: Trains critics for several chunk lengths and picks each state's chunk size by discount-normalized advantage over a per-horizon baseline; OGBench 25-task offline→online success 62→96% vs QC 52→86%.

current_row.title: When Life Gives You BC, Make Q-functions: Extracting Q-values from Behavior Cloning for On-Robot Reinforcement Learning (Q2RL: Q-Estimation and Q-Gating from BC for RL)
current_row.one_line: Reads a Q-function out of BC log-probabilities plus MC values and gates BC vs SAC actions; real peg insertion 0.70 → 1.00, pipe assembly 0.20 → 0.75.

current_row.title: Learning from the Best: Smoothness-Driven Metrics for Data Quality in Imitation Learning (RINSE: Ranking and INdexing Smooth Examples)
current_row.one_line: Smoothness scores retain top-ranked demonstrations. On simulated RoboMimic Transport mh, spectral arc length selects 50 of 300 demos for 55% success versus 39% with all 300; trajectory-envelope distance scores 46%.

current_row.title: dWorldEval: Scalable Robotic Policy Evaluation via Discrete Diffusion World Model
current_row.one_line: Discrete-token masked-diffusion evaluator with failure data. Real AgileX r 0.918 / MMRV 0.02, with better action controllability than video evaluators.

current_row.title: Fisher Decorator: Refining Flow Policy via a Local Transport Map
current_row.one_line: Offline RL: refines a flow policy via a residual local transport map with Fisher-information-weighted (anisotropic) regularization instead of isotropic L2; provable error bound, SOTA on offline RL benchmarks.

current_row.title: OmniVLA-RL: A Vision-Language-Action Model with Spatial Understanding and Online RL
current_row.one_line: Mix-of-Transformers VLA (reasoning, spatial, action experts) with Flow-GSPO: flow matching recast as an SDE and trained with GSPO (Group Sequence Policy Optimization) on action chunks; evaluated on LIBERO and LIBERO-Plus.

current_row.title: Rewind-IL: Online Failure Detection and State Respawning for Imitation Learning
current_row.one_line: Training-free runtime safeguard for a frozen ACT policy: a chunk-consistency failure detector (TIDE, conformal threshold) triggers a respawn to the latest VLM-verified checkpoint state. Real 6-task average: 66.7 → 80.0% unperturbed, 18.3 → 76.7% under adversarial perturbation.

current_row.title: ScoRe-Flow: Complete Distributional Control via Score-Based Reinforcement Learning for Flow Matching
current_row.org: Zhejiang U., SJTU, Shanghai Innovation Institute,…
current_row.one_line: Adds a closed-form score-function drift (computed from the velocity field, no extra network) plus learned noise variance to SDE-based flow-policy RL. Robomimic average success 92.5 vs ReinFlow-S 85.9 and DPPO 75.9; 2.4x faster convergence than ReinFlow on D4RL.

current_row.title: MoRI: Mixture of RL and IL Experts for Long-Horizon Manipulation Tasks
current_row.org: Huazhong University of Science and Technology
current_row.one_line: Gate picks a BC expert or a BC-anchored SAC expert per state; 4 real tasks average 97.5% vs BC 37.5% in 142-288 min.

current_row.title: Human-Robot Copilot for Data-Efficient Imitation Learning
current_row.one_line: Low-cost bidirectional leader arm for HG-DAgger clips; sim Nut Assembly 56 vs 46 total success at 40 trajectories.

current_row.title: Generalizable Dense Reward for Long-Horizon Robotic Tasks (VLLR: Vision-Language Long-horizon Reward)
current_row.one_line: A VLM progress reward used briefly to warm-start the critic, then policy self-certainty as a bonus; PickUp 97.0% vs 91.8% for sparse-reward FLaRe (sim).

current_row.title: VLA-OPD: Bridging Offline SFT and Online RL for Vision-Language-Action Models via On-Policy Distillation
current_row.one_line: DAgger with a neural teacher: reverse-KL on-policy distillation from an RL-tuned VLA teacher; LIBERO avg of a 1-demo SFT student 48.9 to 87.4 (distill only), 93.4 with GRPO (teacher 93.9). Sim only.

current_row.title: PRM-as-a-Judge: A Dense Evaluation Paradigm for Fine-Grained Robotic Auditing
current_row.one_line: Replaces binary success with dense process-reward-model scoring of trajectory progress (OPD metrics), validated on the RoboPulse diagnostic benchmark and used to audit mainstream policies on long-horizon tasks.

current_row.title: AcceRL: A Distributed Asynchronous Reinforcement Learning and World Model Framework for Vision-Language-Action Models
current_row.one_line: Asynchronous VLA RL with plug-in world models. On 4×H200, estimated time to 2,000 steps: 6.5h versus RLinf 15.8h. LIBERO-Spatial: DIAMOND-backed training needs ~200x fewer simulator interactions than model-free AcceRL for comparable return.

current_row.title: Conservative Offline Robot Policy Learning via Posterior-Transition Reweighting
current_row.one_line: PTR: reward-free weighted regression for VLA post-training; a transition scorer's identification posterior-to-uniform ratio reweights heterogeneous mixed-quality samples, compatible with diffusion and flow-matching action heads.

current_row.title: Emergent Dexterity via Diverse Resets and Large-Scale Reinforcement Learning (OmniReset)
current_row.one_line: OmniReset: diverse programmatic simulator resets let large-scale RL learn long-horizon dexterous manipulation without hand-crafted curricula or demos; scales with compute and transfers to real robots above baselines.

current_row.title: ExpertGen: Scalable Sim-to-Real Expert Policy Learning from Imperfect Behavior Priors
current_row.org: RAI Institute; UT Austin; Sony AI
current_row.one_line: DSRL + FastTD3 noise steering in massively parallel sim with binary reward only. On an 8-task AnyTask mean: ExpertGen 85.3 vs DP prior 40.3, residual RL 53.7, DSRL-SAC 37.7.

current_row.title: Simulation Distillation: Pretraining World Models in Simulation for Rapid Real-World Adaptation (SimDist)
current_row.one_line: Pretrain a latent world model in simulation; freeze encoder, reward and value, adapt dynamics on real data and plan with MPPI. Go2 slippery slope: 14/15 successes across three speeds after 35.7 minutes, versus IQL/RLPD 0/15.

current_row.title: Chunk-Guided Q-Learning
current_row.one_line: Offline RL method (CGQ) regularizing a single-step critic toward a chunk-level critic trained with temporally extended backups; tighter optimality bounds, strong long-horizon OGBench results.

current_row.title: SmoothVLA: Aligning Vision-Language-Action Models with Physical Constraints via Intrinsic Smoothness Optimization
current_row.one_line: GRPO fine-tuning of a VLA with a hybrid reward: sparse task success plus dense jerk-based intrinsic smoothness term; 13.8% smoother than standard RL on LIBERO.

current_row.title: Beyond Imitation: Reinforcement Learning Fine-Tuning for Adaptive Diffusion Navigation Policies
current_row.one_line: GRPO (value-network-free) fine-tuning of an imitation-pretrained diffusion navigation policy (NavDP) with selective layer updates; Isaac Sim PointGoal unseen-scene success 52.0% to 58.7%, zero-shot transfer to a real Unitree Go2 quadruped.

current_row.title: RoboStereo: Dual-Tower 4D Embodied World Models for Unified Policy Optimization
current_row.one_line: RGB/pointmap 4D world model supports test-time action verification and imagined GRPO. Combining all three components lifts OpenVLA-OFT mean MimicGen success 27.7% to 54.0%; online GRPO reaches 29.2%, under the same 128-trajectories-per-task interaction budget.

current_row.title: RoboClaw: An Agentic Framework for Scalable Long-Horizon Robotic Tasks
current_row.one_line: VLM-driven agent unifying data collection, policy learning and execution; Entangled Action Pairs give self-resetting autonomous collection loops. Reports 25% higher success than baselines on a real long-horizon vanity-table task and 53.7% less human data-collection time.

current_row.title: World2Act: Latent Action Post-Training from World Model Dynamics
current_row.one_line: Frozen GR00T-N1.6-ft plus a residual policy trained in action latents contrastively aligned with world-model latents. RoboCasa success 70.1% to 72.6%; real-robot average improves 6.7 points over the same fine-tuned baseline.

current_row.title: Quality over Quantity: Demonstration Curation via Influence Functions for Data-Centric Robot Learning (QoQ)
current_row.one_line: Hessian-free max-cosine influence against a small validation set. Robomimic Can-paired 99.2% vs 64.8% with all data; real cabinet opening 25.0% → 43.3%.

current_row.title: DexHiL: A Human-in-the-Loop Framework for Vision-Language-Action Model Post-Training in Dexterous Manipulation
current_row.one_line: Arm-plus-hand takeovers for a dexterous VLA (Being-H0.5), with intervention samples reweighted to 50% of the training distribution; Tissue Extraction after three rounds 19/20 vs DAgger* 16/20 vs data-matched offline 15/20.

current_row.title: Towards Human-Like Manipulation through RL-Augmented Teleoperation and Mixture-of-Dexterous-Experts VLA
current_row.short: Towards Human-Like Manipulation through RL-Augmented Teleoperation and…
current_row.one_line: IMCopilot RL skills assist teleoperation and serve as MoDE-VLA execution primitives; residual expert modules add force and tactile signals to pi0. Mean success across four real tasks is 34% versus pi0’s 15%.

current_row.title: OmniGuide: Universal Guidance Fields for Enhancing Generalist Robot Policies
current_row.one_line: Test-time guidance of VLA action sampling via differentiable attractor/repeller energy fields from 3D foundation models, semantic reasoners and human pose estimators; improves success and safety in sim and real.

current_row.title: Critic in the Loop: A Tri-System VLA Framework for Robust Long-Horizon Manipulation
current_row.one_line: Tri-system hierarchy: VLM planner, fast VLA executor, and lightweight visual critic that routes control, triggering VLM replanning on failures or stalls in long-horizon manipulation.

current_row.title: RoboPocket: Improve Robot Policies Instantly with Your Phone
current_row.org: Shanghai Jiao Tong University; Shanghai Innovation…
current_row.one_line: Robot-free DAgger-style loop: an iPhone handheld gripper previews the policy's predicted trajectory in AR and streams corrections to online finetuning; in a four-user distributed test, Scene 2 rose 0.42 to 0.82 with 12 corrections.

current_row.title: Latent Policy Steering through One-Step Flow Policies
current_row.one_line: Latent actor picks the noise for a one-step MeanFlow policy, and the action-space Q-gradient is backpropagated through the generator. Real average: BC-FM 25/80, DSRL 28/80, LPS 45/80.

current_row.title: Force-Aware Residual DAgger via Trajectory Editing for Precision Insertion with Impedance Control (TER-DAgger)
current_row.one_line: Force-mismatch trigger plus trajectory-edited residual corrections under impedance control for insertion; average success 77.2% vs 40.0% for the best baseline (Finetune) over two simulated and three real insertion tasks.

current_row.title: How to Peel with a Knife: Aligning Fine-Grained Manipulation with Human Preference
current_row.one_line: Human quality scores train a per-step reward, and a residual is fitted with exp(beta*r)-weighted BC. Apple 60% → 100%, while IQL-weighted BC scored 0%.

current_row.title: π-StepNFT: Wider Space Needs Finer Steps in Online RL for Flow-based VLAs
current_row.one_line: Critic-free, likelihood-free step-wise ranking on Flow-SDE rollouts. pi0 LIBERO 57.6 → 90.5, trailing piRL PPO at 96.0. ManiSkill OOD 50.4 vs PPO 39.3.

current_row.title: Keyframe-Guided Structured Rewards for Reinforcement Learning in Long-Horizon Laboratory Robotics
current_row.short: Keyframe-Guided Structured Rewards for Reinforcement Learning in Long-Horizon…
current_row.one_line: Extracts kinematics-aware keyframes from demos, diffusion-predicts stage targets, builds geometric progress rewards for online VLA fine-tuning; 82% after 40-60 min on four lab tasks vs HG-DAgger 42%, HiL-ConRFT 47%.

current_row.title: SPARR: Simulation-based Policies with Asymmetric Real-world Residuals for Assembly
current_row.one_line: Frozen sim PPO assembly policy plus a real-world image and force residual trained RLPD-style, seeded with the prior's own successes. 95-100% on 10 AutoMate tasks in 0.5 h, with no human in the loop.

current_row.title: FlowCorrect: Efficient Interactive Correction of Generative Flow Policies for Robotic Manipulation
current_row.one_line: VR 'nudges' train a tiny LoRA patch on a frozen flow policy; hard Pick-and-Place cases 0/40 to 32/40.

current_row.title: AdaWorldPolicy: World-Model-Driven Diffusion Policy with Online Adaptive Learning for Robotic Manipulation
current_row.one_line: Couples world model, action expert and force predictor as flow-matching DiTs; online adaptive learning alternates action generation and future imagination to update modules under visual/physical domain shift.

current_row.title: RoboCurate: Harnessing Diversity with Action-Verified Neural Trajectory for Robot Learning
current_row.one_line: Filters generated robot videos by comparing their motion with simulator replays of annotated actions. Relative success gains over real-data-only: +70.1% GR-1 Tabletop (300 demos), +16.1% DexMimicGen pretraining, +179.9% real ALLEX humanoid.

current_row.title: Stable Asynchrony: Variance-Controlled Off-Policy RL for LLMs
current_row.one_line: VCPO scales the learning rate by effective sample size and adds a critic-free minimum-variance baseline for stale-rollout policy gradients; stable even 128 steps off-policy, and matches synchronous performance 2.5x faster on a long-horizon tool-use task.

current_row.title: World Action Models are Zero-shot Policies (DreamZero)
current_row.short: World Action Models are Zero-shot Policies (DreamZero)
current_row.one_line: 14B autoregressive video-diffusion World Action Model jointly predicting future video and actions at 7Hz; real-robot task progress over 2x the best pretrained VLA on unseen tasks/environments; 10-20 min video-only cross-embodiment data: >42% relative gain on unseen tasks.

current_row.title: Dual-Granularity Contrastive Reward via Generated Episodic Guidance for Efficient Embodied RL (DEG)
current_row.short: Dual-Granularity Contrastive Reward via Generated Episodic Guidance for Efficient…
current_row.one_line: Video generation model produces per-episode task guidance; coarse- and fine-grained contrastive latent rewards against it drive manipulation RL without human annotations across 18 sim and real tasks.

current_row.title: Accelerating Robotic Reinforcement Learning with Agent Guidance (AGPS: Agent-guided Policy Search)
current_row.one_line: Replaces the HIL-SERL human with a failure-detector-gated VLM agent; USB insertion 100% at 8 min with zero human interventions.

current_row.title: GigaBrain-0.5M*: a VLA That Learns From World Model-Based Reinforcement Learning
current_row.one_line: RECAP-style conditioning plus world-model future latents and value. Box Packing about 60 pretrain / 75 AWR / 60 RECAP / 95% RAMP (bar readings).

current_row.title: Preference Aligned Visuomotor Diffusion Policies for Deformable Object Manipulation (RKO)
current_row.one_line: Preference fine-tuning of a pretrained diffusion policy on preferred vs dispreferred real cloth-folding demos; RKO merges KTO's per-sample labels with RPO's similarity reweighting. Best in 4/9 settings; Trousers Pref 1: 0.910 vs 0.701 for vanilla DDPM.

current_row.title: SERNF: Sample-Efficient Real-World Dexterous Policy Fine-Tuning via Action-Chunked Critics and Normalizing Flows (the v4 PDF is titled "SERNF: Sample-Efficient Real-World Dexterous Fine-Tuning with Normalizing-Flow Policies")
current_row.one_line: Normalizing-flow chunk policy (exact likelihood) with a chunk critic; real dexterous scissors cut success 0.16 → 0.84 with 60 online rollouts.

current_row.title: χ0 (kai0): Resource-Aware Robust Manipulation via Taming Distributional Inconsistencies
current_row.one_line: Open garment-folding pipeline: model soup plus stage-aware advantage (RECAP-style, eps = 0.3) plus train-deploy alignment on pi0.5. Task A success about 27% → 97% (bar readings, 30 trials).

current_row.title: RLinf-USER: A Unified and Extensible System for Real-World Online Policy Learning in Embodied AI
current_row.one_line: Infrastructure, not an algorithm: a fully asynchronous system for real-robot online learning. Peg insertion (CNN, RLPD) converges in about 1500 s vs 8000+ s with a synchronous pipeline; pi0 Pick-and-Place 39/60 → 58/60 with HG-DAgger.

current_row.title: DreamDojo: A Generalist Robot World Model from Large-Scale Human Videos
current_row.one_line: World model pretrained on 44k h of human video with latent actions. Checkpoint ranking r = 0.995 / MMRV 0.003 on AgiBot fruit packing (human-scored).

current_row.title: World-VLA-Loop: Closed-Loop Learning of Video World Model and VLA Policy
current_row.one_line: Cosmos world model with a built-in reward head, trained on success plus near-success data and refreshed with policy rollouts. Real Place Cup 13.3% → 50.0% after 2 loops.

current_row.title: RL-VLA³: A Flexible and Asynchronous Reinforcement Learning Framework for VLA Training
current_row.one_line: Fully asynchronous distributed RL framework for VLA post-training (decoupled simulation, inference, training; dynamic batching, environment sharding); up to 85.2% higher throughput than synchronous baselines, scaling 8 to 256 GPUs.

current_row.title: Reparameterization Flow Policy Optimization
current_row.one_line: RFO trains flow policies with reparameterization policy gradients, backpropagating through ODE action generation and differentiable dynamics; almost 2x SOTA baseline reward on a soft-body quadruped task.

current_row.title: Maximum Likelihood Reinforcement Learning
current_row.one_line: Shows expected-reward RL is a first-order approximation of maximum likelihood under binary terminal feedback; MaxRL interpolates between them as sampling compute scales, up to 20x test-time scaling efficiency over GRPO.

current_row.title: TQL: Scaling Q-Functions with Transformers by Preventing Attention Collapse
current_row.one_line: Attention-entropy regularization lets transformer critics improve with size (43% gain from 0.4M to 26M); 25-task average 40±7 vs floq 34±7.

current_row.title: Green-VLA: Staged Vision-Language-Action Model for Generalist Robots
current_row.one_line: Five-stage VLA curriculum (VLM, grounding, multi-embodiment pretraining on 3,000 h, embodiment adaptation) ending in an RL policy-alignment stage; adds progress prediction and anomaly detection at inference.

current_row.title: Reinforcement Learning via Self-Distillation
current_row.one_line: SDPO: LLM conditioned on rich textual feedback (e.g. runtime errors) acts as self-teacher, distilling next-token predictions into the policy; at test time on very hard coding questions, matches best-of-k discovery with ~3x fewer attempts.

current_row.title: One Step Is Enough: Dispersive MeanFlow Policy Optimization (DMPO), renamed OGPO: One-Step Generative Policy Optimization for Real-Time Robot Control
current_row.one_line: One-step MeanFlow policy with a dispersive loss, fine-tuned by PPO on a one-step Gaussian chain plus BC regularization. Square 0.83 at 1 NFE vs DPPO 0.78 at 20 NFE. Without the BC term (v1 ablation), success collapses to near zero.

current_row.title: Real-Time Robot Execution with Masked Action Chunking
current_row.short: Real-Time Robot Execution with Masked Action Chunking
current_row.one_line: REMAC (ICLR 2026): LoRA fine-tuning with masked action prefixes and a self-conditioned curriculum adapts pretrained policies to asynchronous inference. Prefix-preserved sampling maintains chunk continuity; reports higher completion rates and faster execution without added inference overhead.

current_row.title: Self-Distillation Enables Continual Learning
current_row.one_line: SDFT: a demonstration-conditioned model acts as its own teacher for on-policy distillation, learning new skills from demos with less forgetting than supervised fine-tuning (foundation models, not robot-specific).

current_row.title: DeFlow: Decoupling Manifold Modeling and Value Maximization for Offline Policy Extraction
current_row.one_line: Offline RL with a flow-matching behavior policy plus a lightweight refinement module in a data-derived trust region, avoiding ODE-solver backprop; strong OGBench results and efficient offline-to-online adaptation.

current_row.title: Failure-Aware RL: Reliable Offline-to-Online Reinforcement Learning with Self-Recovery for Real-World Manipulation (FARL)
current_row.org: Shanghai Qi Zhi Institute, SJTU, Tsinghua and others
current_row.one_line: World-model safety critic predicts near-future failures and hands control to an offline-trained recovery policy during PPO-based (Uni-O4) offline-to-online RL; real Franka tasks: 73.1% fewer intervention-requiring failures than Uni-O4 (mean of per-task reductions).
